step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identified core system entities from visual whiteboard and transcript: EKS cluster hosting multi-tenant SaaS application pods, Postgres Aurora database storing tenant schemas, Transit Gateway for VPC connectivity, Control Tower for provisioning single-tenant accounts, QuickSight for tenant data visualization, AWS VPN for hybrid connectivity, and ThirdParty Customer Data (on-premises database).
2. Validated service names against allowed vocabulary list: EKS, Aurora, TransitGateway, ControlTower, QuickSight, VPN, and ThirdParty.
3. Defined logical flows based on audio transcript and visual flow directions:
   - Flow 0: EKS pods write multi-tenant loan origination data into isolated schemas in Aurora.
   - Flow 1: QuickSight queries data from Aurora through Transit Gateway across VPC peering connections.
   - Flow 2: On-premises customer database sends data through VPN into QuickSight to combine on-prem data with loan origination data.
   - Flow 3: Control Tower pre-provisions new single-tenant AWS accounts with QuickSight using Account Factory for Terraform.

graph.name: Summit Technology Group Single-Tenant Data Consumption Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture for Summit Technology Group's multi-tenant loan origination system on AWS EKS and Aurora, enabling single-tenant data consumption via QuickSight, Transit Gateway, AWS Control Tower, and VPN integration to on-premises customer data.

nodes.name: EKS
nodes.notes: Hosts multi-tenant SaaS loan origination system running on dedicated pods per tenant for isolation.

nodes.name: AURORA
nodes.notes: PostgreSQL database storing customer data in isolated schemas per tenant.

nodes.name: TRANSIT GATEWAY
nodes.notes: Peers multi-tenant application VPC with single-tenant customer analytics VPCs.

nodes.name: CONTROL TOWER
nodes.notes: Automates onboarding of new tenants by provisioning new single-tenant AWS accounts via Account Factory for Terraform.

nodes.name: QUICKSIGHT
nodes.notes: Pre-provisioned in single-tenant accounts to allow customers to visualize loan origination data.

nodes.name: VPN
nodes.notes: Establishes secure IPSec connection to customer on-premises data sources (or Direct Connect).

nodes.name: CUST DATA
nodes.notes: On-premises customer data sources from community banks integrated into QuickSight dashboards.

edges.notes: EKS pods write application data into tenant-isolated Aurora database schemas.
QuickSight sends query traffic through Transit Gateway to access backend database.
Transit Gateway routes data requests from QuickSight to Postgres Aurora.
On-premises customer data travels across VPN into the single-tenant AWS environment.
VPN delivers on-premises bank data to QuickSight to combine with loan origination data.
Control Tower provisions the single-tenant account pre-configured with QuickSight.
